name: Do I need a general contractor for foreclosed property interior repairs?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a general contractor for foreclosed property interior repairs?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, hiring a general contractor is highly recommended for foreclosed property interior repairs, especially for projects involving multiple trades or significant structural work. A general contractor coordinates all aspects of the project, including permits, subcontractors (plumbers, electricians, carpenters), material procurement, and scheduling. This ensures the work is completed efficiently, adheres to local codes, and meets quality standards, simplifying the process for the property owner.
